paragraphs: From Kilrush, depart left onto the N68 and continue for about 650 metres
Take the next right, staying on the N68 for roughly half a kilometre
Turn right onto the R473 follow the road out along this stretch for about 2 km as you settle into the drive
Continue straight as the road becomes Moore Street
Take the next right into Market Square at the end of the road turn left, still on Market Square, and follow it for about 600 metres before turning right into Shannon Heights
Work your way through the estate, keeping left
Left again as the road bends through Shannon Heights
After the estate loop, perform a controlled U-turn on Shannon Heights when it is safe, then at the end of the road turn right and continue through, keeping left
At the next end of road turn left onto Fahy's Road, carry straight on as it becomes Henry Street
Turn left back onto Market Square and keep right through the square
Turn left onto Shanakyle Road and follow it for about 500 metres
Turn right to stay on Shanakyle Road you will be asked to pull in and complete a U-turn here, so take your time with observations
At the end of the road turn left back onto Shanakyle Road
Right onto O'Gorman Street continue straight as O'Gorman Street becomes Frances Street
Turn right into Market Square and right again at the end of the road
Take the next left onto Moore Street right onto Stewart Street
Turn right onto the N67 right into Kilrush Rural ED for another U-turn practice stop
Rejoin by turning left back onto the N67 at the end of the road turn right onto Lower Moore Street, left onto High Street
Right onto Ennis Road for about 1.5 km of open road driving
Turn right onto the N68, then work through the quieter side roads with a right and a left, using the space for a reverse or turnabout if directed
To finish, head back toward Kilrush along O'Dea's Road and turn right into Donneen Park, keeping left to arrive back at the test centre
